{{Top}}
'''Orchids''' were a kind of plant native to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] had hybrid native
orchids in [[Pellaeon Gardens|his gardens]].
